title: Social Assistance Act 13 of 2004
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Social Assistance Act 13 of 2004'. Commencement: 1 April 2006, except Chapter 4, which commenced on 1 April 2021 (Gazette 44299). Amended by Act 16 of 2020.
notes: Covers the older person's, disability, child support, foster child, care dependency and war veterans grants and social relief of distress.
